<div class="card-body">
'''Figrin D'an''' is the Japanese-language [[Premiere (Japanese)]] printing of [[Figrin D'an]].<ref name="encyclopedia">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41 and 98 (index 3967). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>


<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">フィグリン・ダン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">毎ターン、自分の支配フェイズに、１フォース消費して、賭をすることができる。運命数を３枚引く。相手は２枚引く。合計の多いほうが、ロストデッキからランダムに１枚カードを取り戻せる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-figrin-d-an-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">ビス人男性。ミュージシャンで、モス・アイズリーの酒場のバンド、フィグリン・ダン・アンド・モーダル・ノーズを率いる。ギャンブラーで、いかさま師。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Figrin D'an.

'''Card text:''' During your control phase each turn, you may use 1 Force to gamble. Draw three destinies, and your opponent draws two. The player with the higher total may retrieve one random card from their Lost Pile.

'''Lore:''' A male Bith musician who leads Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes, the band at the Mos Eisley cantina. A gambler and cheat.
